quote: mine got disenchanted into some Chromatic Dust
notes: Original first-person singular item observation distinct from Kenthenerd's earlier compiled eight-item reference list. The author's 'mine' reports one Everflowing Inkwell disenchant with Chromatic Dust present; one completed event and one material-positive event are directly countable, NOT a multi-operation experiment or population drop probability. Source gives no dust stack quantity, zeros, quality rank, other outcomes, character skill, specialization, build or observation date. Do not import as an independent copy of Kenthenerd or inflate measured confidence; studyKey identifies Lazey alone.
